meta.name: Manage salon and barbershop appointments with Google Calendar and Sheets

parameters.content:
## Salon/Barbershop Receptionist - Multi-calendar System

### How it works

This workflow acts as a multi-calendar receptionist for a salon or barbershop, exposing separate webhook endpoints for booking, rescheduling, cancellation, and call logging. It validates incoming requests, looks up barber-to-calendar mappings in Google Sheets, checks Google Calendar availability, creates or updates appointments, cancels events, and returns clear webhook responses including alternatives when requested slots are unavailable. It also records analyzed call logs to a Google Sheet.

### Setup steps

- Configure Google Calendar credentials in n8n for all calendar read, create, update, and delete nodes.
- Configure Google Sheets credentials for the barber calendar lookup sheet and the call log destination sheet.
- Populate the barber mapping sheet with barber names or identifiers and their corresponding Google Calendar IDs, plus any allowed-calendar data used by booking ID validation.
- Review the Set and Code nodes for appointment duration, working hours, search range, phone matching, booking ID format, and response payload fields.
- Activate the workflow and connect the four webhook URLs to the receptionist, phone agent, website, or booking interface that will call them.

### Customization

Adjust working hours, appointment duration, number of alternative suggestions, phone matching rules, and response messages to match the salon’s policies and preferred customer experience.

## Reschedule request intake

Receives reschedule webhook calls, validates the payload, and branches based on whether the request is structurally valid.

## Reschedule routing setup

Prepares reschedule timing and phone fields, then determines whether the request includes a booking ID.

## Validate reschedule calendar

Looks up allowed calendars for booking-ID based reschedules and checks whether the provided calendar is permitted.

## Invalid reschedule reply

Returns an invalid-request response for malformed reschedule requests or disallowed requests without a usable phone fallback.

## Find reschedule by phone

Handles reschedule requests that need phone-based lookup by resolving the barber calendar and searching for an existing appointment.

## Match reschedule event

Tags the calendar source, finds the matching appointment from search results, and decides whether an appointment was found.

## Reschedule lookup replies

Handles ambiguous or missing appointment search results and returns the appropriate reschedule response.

## Resolve reschedule target

Builds the target event and calendar identifiers from either a provided booking ID or a matched appointment.

## Check reschedule slot

Checks the target calendar for availability at the requested new time and branches based on whether the slot is open.

## Apply reschedule update

Updates the calendar event when the requested slot is free and returns either a success response or a system-error response.

## Suggest reschedule alternatives

When the requested reschedule slot is unavailable, fetches nearby events, calculates open slots, and returns alternative times.

## Booking request intake

Receives booking requests, validates them, returns invalid-input errors, and routes valid requests based on whether a specific barber was supplied.

## Read all barbers

Loads all barber calendar mappings and iterates over them for requests where no specific barber was selected.

## Scan barber availability

Fetches calendar events for each barber in the loop and tags the events with their source calendar and barber.

## Assign or suggest

Analyzes all barber availability, checks whether any calendar data was readable, and decides whether a barber can be assigned.

## Any-barber booking replies

Books the appointment on the assigned barber calendar or returns suggestions when no direct assignment is possible.

## Named barber lookup

Looks up the requested barber’s calendar and returns a not-found response if the barber is not configured.

## Named slot check

Applies booking configuration, checks the selected barber calendar, and determines whether the requested slot is available.

## Confirm named booking

Creates the appointment for the specified barber and returns a successful booking response.

## Named alternative times

If the requested slot is busy, reads events, calculates the closest available times, formats suggestions, and returns them.

## Booking system error

Central booking error response for calendar or sheet failures across both named-barber and any-barber booking paths.

## Cancel request intake

Receives cancellation requests, validates the payload, and routes the request based on whether a booking ID is present.

## Validate cancel calendar

Checks whether a booking-ID cancellation references an allowed calendar before allowing direct cancellation.

## Cancel phone fallback

For non-allowed or no-booking-ID cancellation cases, checks for a valid phone fallback, looks up the barber calendar, searches events, or returns invalid input.

## Execute cancellation

Cancels a provided or matched calendar event, then returns either a cancellation success response or a system-error response.

## Match cancel event

Tags phone-search results with source data, selects the matching appointment to cancel, and checks whether an event was found.

## Cancel lookup replies

Handles cancellation searches that are ambiguous or have no matching appointment and returns the corresponding webhook response.

## Log request filter

Receives call log webhooks, checks whether the call has been analyzed, and ignores records that are not ready to log.

## Save call log

Appends analyzed call data to Google Sheets and confirms the log was saved.
